answer: Attentional Provenance Ledger. Each identity must answer unpredictable micro-queries within a latency window; responses accumulate a pigment of history, and only accounts with dense, continuous traces earn routing priority. A quill writes each answer to a timestamped chain, and an opal marker flags irregular gaps. Sybils must staff sustained human attention per identity, paying continuous labor and monitoring cost, so clones become economically unviable.
